competitiveTarget: Beat Coldwell Banker / Windermere city pages — the kinetic-brutalist homepage look applied at city scope: live single-family market data, the in-city listing map + zoom, per-city featured tours, neighborhoods, communities, open houses, and live activity no competitor surfaces.
note: KB (kinetic-brutalist) design language — Phase 9 wave 1 (docs/KB_CONVERGENCE_ROADMAP.md). The city page reuses the SAME section library as the homepage (components/site/kb/*), fed city-scoped DAL data, never forked (ci:kb-single-source G50). KbNav + KbFooter carry chrome (default SiteHeader/SiteFooter hidden for ^/cities/[slug] via HideChrome). Body lives in main.kb-root + SmoothScrollProvider. THE PAGE CONTRACT: KB design + SEO for Google & LLMs (pageMetadata + MetadataBlock JSON-LD: Breadcrumb/City/Dataset/FAQPage) + tracking (CityPageTracker). Supersedes the Experience System Geo archetype v3.2; every former section was rebuilt in KB form.
